notes: «عنه» opens the report and the context carries no previous report, so it is written as a back_reference, not completed; «مثله» says the matn is like the previous one; «عليهما السلام» is a blessing; «أحدهما» is one of the two Imams (unnamed, the text does not say which); the second report («حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ») starts a new isnad after the first, so it is its own group
